properties.discussion:
An area of low pressure, associated with a tropical wave, is located  a few hundred miles west-southwest of the Cabo Verde Islands.   Showers and thunderstorms associated with this system have changed  little in organization over the past several hours.  Environmental  conditions are somewhat favorable for development over the next  couple of days, and a tropical depression could form over the next  day or two as the system moves westward to west-northwestward near  20 mph across the eastern and central tropical Atlantic.   Environmental conditions are forecast to become less conducive by  this weekend, potentially ending its chances for development.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...60 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...60 percent.

A broad area of low pressure located well south of southwestern  Mexico is producing a large area of showers and thunderstorms that  continues to gradually become better organized. Environmental  conditions are expected to support gradual development of this  system, and a tropical depression is likely to form during the next  day or so while it moves west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph, well  offshore of Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...90 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

An area of low pressure could form this weekend well to the south of  southwestern Mexico. Environmental conditions appear favorable for  some gradual development of this system, and a tropical depression  could form by early next week while it moves westward to  west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...60 percent.

An elongated, broad area of low pressure located well to the  east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands is producing disorganized  showers and thunderstorms. Environmental conditions appear conducive  for gradual development of this system, and a tropical depression is  likely to form late this week or early this weekend while the system  drifts to the northeast, then turns westward. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...50 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.

An area of low pressure could form well south of the Hawaiian  Islands late this week or over the weekend. Some gradual development  is possible by early next week while the system moves slowly  west-northwestward, well south-southwest of the Hawaiian Islands. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
